posts.name: Abubakar
posts.cooked:
I have set up an Assignment Rule on a DocType. When I try to import data (e.g. 100 records from an Excel sheet), the import fails due to the Assignment Rule—even though the rule itself is configured correctly.

If I disable the Assignment Rule, the import works fine. However, afterward, I can only apply the Assignment Rule manually to 5 records at a time.

Is there a better way to apply Assignment Rules in bulk—especially during or after data import?
